general_information.Description: At the end of this course, students will be able to perceive: 1) Background knowledge: (ABET e) -The role of operating system, - important OS concepts, - the mechanism of operating system, and - main problems of Operating system. 2) Practice skills: (ABET k) - Using basic shell command in Linux system fluently. - Fundamental of shell, C language on Linux. - Main problems of Operating system through some simulative exercises. 3) Information searching, reading and selection skills (ABET i) 4) Working in group, documenting and presenation skills (ABET g)
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU LMS https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Linux operating system server and/ or desktop - MARIE simulator - AI tools (ChatGPT/Copilot/Gamma…) and other simulation software if deemed appropriate.
